mo_ta_cong_viec:
We are re-platforming a national public-sector system in the EU: ~750 screens of a legacy client-server 4GL (Uniface), rebuilt as a modern Java/Spring + React application on top of an Oracle database.
The hardest question on this project is not "does the new code work" — it is "does the new system do exactly what the old one does". Every migration wave has to clear that bar before it goes live. At 750 screens and thousands of business rules, that cannot be proven by hand — it has to be proven by a test system: an automated, repeatable verification machine that compares old and new on every wave.
That machine does not exist yet. You build it. You design the test architecture, you set up the AI-driven workflow that turns business rules into executable tests at scale, you lead two QA/BA engineers who work inside that system, and you make the go / no-go call for every wave. You work from the specification owned by the BA Lead — and you send it back when it is not testable.What you will do
Test each migration wave against the legacy system and verify that the new system behaves as expected.
Design and execute functional, regression, integration and exploratory tests.
Create detailed test cases and test scenarios based on business requirements and specifications.
Investigate the legacy application to understand existing workflows, validations and business rules.
Compare old and new system behaviour and identify functional differences.
Check data directly in Oracle using SQL to verify that records and business results are correct.
Report defects clearly, including steps to reproduce, expected results, actual results and supporting evidence.
Retest fixes and perform regression testing before releases.
Support UAT with the client, including test scenario preparation, execution and issue tracking.
Work closely with developers and BA team members to analyse and resolve defects.
Contribute to the automated regression suite and gradually expand automation coverage.
Maintain test documentation and ensure adequate coverage for each migration wave.
Use AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to support test-case creation, test analysis, documentation and repetitive QA activities.

Perks & benefits for well-being and balance
Access to top tech and modern engineering
A culture of growth, collaboration & learning

8seneca is committed to building a workplace where employees can grow, contribute, and thrive.
1. Engaging perks and benefits for your well-being
We offer a competitive package including 13th-month salary, on-time salary payments, and project bonuses based on revenue. Employees are fully covered with 100% salary-based insurance, advanced healthcare insurance, annual health check-ups, and Tet/holiday gifts.
Work-life balance is supported with 14 days annual leave plus 3 Christmas days, flexible working arrangements (3 days WFH for senior lever up), modern office facilities, team-building trips (4D3N at 5-star resorts), and wellness support such as vitamins in the office. In addition, the office provides coffee machines, snacks, and fresh fruits to support daily comfort and energy.
2. World-class technology and impactful projects
You will work with modern technologies in AI, Data, Cloud, and Software Engineering on large-scale international projects for European clients, including strategic initiatives for our company—one of the top IT companies in Europe. We also provide access to modern AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude Code to support productivity and engineering excellence.
3. A culture of growth, collaboration, and learning
We foster continuous learning through mentorship programs, 1-1 feedback, and performance reviews. Employees are empowered to take ownership, make decisions, and learn from mistakes in a safe, supportive environment. A shared company library also promotes continuous self-development.
At 8seneca, you will work with talented people from diverse backgrounds, united by a passion for technology and innovation.
